verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ يَا بَاسِطَ الْيَدَيْنِ بِالْعَطِيَّةْ ۞ يَا مَنْ إِذَا رُفِعَتْ إِلَيْهِ أَكُفُّ الْعَبْدِ كَفَاهْ ۞ يَا مَنْ تَنَزَّهَ فِي ذَاتِهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ الْأَحَدِيَّةْ ۞ عَنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ فِيهَا نَظَائِرُ وَأَشْبَاهْ ۞ يَا مَنْ تَفَرَّدَ بِالْبَقَاءِ وَالْقِدَمِ وَالْأَزَلِيَّةْ ۞ يَا مَنْ لَا يُرْجَى غَيْرُهُ وَلَا يُعَوَّلُ عَلٰى سِوَاهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma yā bāsiṭa l-yadayni bi-l-ʿaṭiyyah, yā man idhā rufiʿat ilayhi akuffu l-ʿabdi kafāh, yā man tanazzaha fī dhātihi wa-ṣifātihi l-aḥadiyyah, ʿan an yakūna lahu fīhā naẓā'iru wa-ashbāh, yā man tafarrada bi-l-baqā'i wa-l-qidami wa-l-azaliyyah, yā man lā yurjā ghayruhu wa-lā yuʿawwalu ʿalā siwāh.
verses.en: O Allah, O You who extend both hands in giving, O You who, when the slave raises his hands to You, suffice him. O You who, in Your Essence and Attributes of Oneness, are exalted beyond all likeness and comparison. O You who alone possess everlastingness, beginninglessness, and eternality. O You besides whom none is hoped in and upon none besides whom reliance is placed.

verses.ar: يَا مَنِ اسْتَنَدَ الْأَنَامُ إِلَى قُدْرَتِهِ الْقَيُّومِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَرْشَدَ بِفَضْلِهِ مَنِ اسْتَرْشَدَهُ وَاسْتَهْدَاهْ ۞ نَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنْوَارِكَ الْقُدْسِيَّةِ ۞ الَّتِي أَزَاحَتْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الشَّكِّ دُجَاهْ ۞ وَنَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِشَرَفِ الذَّاتِ الْمُحَمَّدِيَّةْ ۞ وَمَنْ هُوَ آخِرُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ بِصُورَتِهِ وَأَوَّلُهُمْ بِمَعْنَاهْ ۞ وَبِآلِهِ كَوَاكِبِ أَمْنِ الْبَرِيَّةْ ۞ وَسَفِينَةِ السَّلَامَةِ وَالنَّجَاةْ
verses.tr: Yā mani-stanada l-anāmu ilā qudratihi l-qayyūmiyyah, wa-arshada bi-faḍlihi mani-starshadahu wa-s-tahdāh, nas'aluka bi-anwārika l-qudsiyyah, allatī azāḥat min ẓulumāti sh-shakki dujāh, wa-natawassalu ilayka bi-sharafi dh-dhāti l-Muḥammadiyyah, wa-man huwa ākhiru l-anbiyā'i bi-ṣūratihi wa-awwaluhum bi-maʿnāh, wa-bi-ālihi kawākibi amni l-bariyyah, wa-safīnati s-salāmati wa-n-najāh.
verses.en: O You upon whose sustaining power all creation depends, and who by Your grace guide those who seek guidance and direction from You. We ask You by Your sacred lights, which dispelled the deep darkness of doubt, and we seek a means of approach to You through the honour of the Muhammadan Essence, he who is the last of the prophets in outward form and the first of them in meaning, and through his family, the stars of safety for creation and the ship of safety and salvation.

verses.ar: وَبِأَصْحَابِهِ أُولِي الْهِدَايَةِ وَالْأَفْضَلِيَّةْ ۞ الَّذِينَ بَذَلُوا نُفُوسَهُمْ لِلّٰهِ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِنَ اللّٰهْ ۞ وَبِحَمَلَةِ شَرِيعَتِهِ أُولِي الْمَنَاقِبِ وَالْخُصُوصِيَّةْ ۞ الَّذِينَ اسْتَبْشَرُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ وَفَضْلٍ مِنَ اللّٰهْ ۞ أَنْ تُوَفِّقَنَا فِي الْأَقْوَالِ وَالْأَعْمَالِ لِإِخْلَاصِ النِّيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-bi-aṣḥābihi ūli l-hidāyati wa-l-afḍaliyyah, alladhīna badhalū nufūsahum li-Llāhi yabtaghūna faḍlan mina Llāh, wa-bi-ḥamalati sharīʿatihi ūli l-manāqibi wa-l-khuṣūṣiyyah, alladhīna-s-tabsharū bi-niʿmatin wa-faḍlin mina Llāh, an tuwaffiqanā fī l-aqwāli wa-l-aʿmāli li-ikhlāṣi n-niyyah.
verses.en: And through his Companions, possessors of guidance and excellence, who devoted themselves to Allah, seeking bounty from Allah, and through the bearers of his Sacred Law, possessors of virtues and distinction, who rejoiced in blessing and bounty from Allah, we ask You to grant us success in making our intentions sincere in all our words and deeds.

verses.ar: وَتُنْجِحَ لِكُلٍّ مِنَ الْحَاضِرِينَ مَطْلَبَهُ وَمُنَاهْ ۞ وَتُخَلِّصَنَا مِنْ أَسْرِ الشَّهَوَاتِ وَالْأَدْوَاءِ الْقَلْبِيَّةْ ۞ وَتُحَقِّقَ لَنَا مِنَ الْآمَالِ مَا بِكَ ظَنَنَّاهْ ۞ وَتَكْفِيَنَا كُلَّ مُدْلَهِمَّةٍ وَبَلِيَّةْ ۞ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ أَهْوَاهُ هَوَاهْ ۞ وَتُدْنِيَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْيَقِينِ قُطُوفًا دَانِيَةً جَنِيَّةْ ۞ وَتَمْحُوَ عَنَّا كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ جَنَيْنَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-tunjiḥa li-kullin mina l-ḥāḍirīna maṭlabahu wa-munāh, wa-tukhalliṣanā min asri sh-shahawāti wa-l-adwā'i l-qalbiyyah, wa-tuḥaqqiqa lanā mina l-āmāli mā bika ẓanannāh, wa-takfiyanā kulla mudlahimmatin wa-baliyyah, wa-lā tajʿalnā mimman ahwāhu hawāh, wa-tudniya lanā min ḥusni l-yaqīni quṭūfan dāniyatan janiyyah, wa-tamḥuwa ʿannā kulla dhanbin janaynāh.
verses.en: And fulfil for each of those present his request and desire, and free us from the bondage of passions and the diseases of the heart. And fulfil for us the hopes we have placed in You, and suffice us against every overwhelming adversity and calamity. And do not make us among those whom their own desires have led astray. And bring within our reach the ripe and abundant fruits of true certainty, and erase from us every sin we have committed.

verses.ar: وَتَسْتُرَ لِكُلٍّ مِنَّا عَيْبَهُ وَعَجْزَهُ وَحَصْرَهُ وَعِيَّهْ ۞ وَتُسَهِّلَ لَنَا مِنْ صَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ مَا عَزَّ ذُرَاهْ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّكَ جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ سَائِلٍ مَقَامًا وَمَزِيَّةْ ۞ وَلِكُلِّ رَاجٍ مَا أَمَّلَهُ فِيكَ وَرَجَاهْ ۞ وَقَدْ سَأَلْنَاكَ رَاجِينَ مَوَاهِبَكَ اللَّدُنِّيَّةْ ۞ فَحَقِّقْ لَنَا مَا مِنْكَ رَجَوْنَاهْ ۞ وَتَعُمَّ جَمْعَنَا هَذَا مِنْ خَزَائِنِ مِنَحِكَ السَّنِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-tastura li-kullin minnā ʿaybahu wa-ʿajzahu wa-ḥaṣrahu wa-ʿiyyah wa-tusahhila lanā min ṣāliḥi l-aʿmāli mā ʿazza dhurāh, Allāhumma innaka jaʿalta li-kulli sā'ilin maqāman wa-maziyyah wa-li-kulli rājin mā ammalahu fīka wa-rajāh wa-qad sa'alnāka rājīna mawāhibaka l-ladunniyyah, fa-ḥaqqiq lanā mā minka rajawnāh wa-taʿumma jamʿanā hādhā min khazā'ini minaḥika s-saniyyah.
verses.en: And conceal for each of us his faults, his weakness, his inability, and his inarticulateness, and make easy for us those righteous deeds whose heights are difficult to attain. O Allah, You have appointed for every seeker a station and distinction, and for everyone who hopes in You that which he hopes for and seeks from You. And we have asked You, hoping for Your divine gifts, so fulfil for us what we have hoped for from You, and encompass this gathering of ours with the treasures of Your sublime gifts.

verses.ar: بِرَحْمَةٍ وَمَغْفِرَةٍ وَتُدِيمَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ غِنَاهْ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ آمِنِ الرَّوْعَاتِ وَأَصْلِحِ الرُّعَاةَ وَالرَّعِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَعْظِمِ الْأَجْرَ لِمَنْ جَعَلَ هَذَا الْخَيْرَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَأَجْرَاهْ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ هَذِهِ الْبَلْدَةَ وَسَائِرَ بِلَادِ الْإِسْلَامِ آمِنَةً رَخِيَّةْ ۞ وَاسْقِنَا غَيْثًا يَعُمُّ انْسِيَابُ سَيْبِهِ السَّبْسَبَ وَرُبَاهْ
verses.tr: Bi-raḥmatin wa-maghfiratin wa-tudīma ʿamman siwāka ghināh, Allāhumma āmini r-rawʿāti wa-aṣliḥi r-ruʿāta wa-r-raʿiyyah, wa-aʿẓimi l-ajra li-man jaʿala hādhā l-khayra fī hādhā l-yawmi wa-ajrāh, Allāhumma-jʿal hādhihi l-baldata wa-sā'ira bilādi al-Islāmi āminatan rakhiyyah, wa-s-qinā ghaythan yaʿummu nsiyābu saybihi s-sabsaba wa-rubāh.
verses.en: With mercy and forgiveness, and grant us lasting independence from all besides You. O Allah, grant safety from all fears, and set right the leaders and the people. And magnify the reward of the one who caused this good to take place on this day and brought it about. O Allah, make this land and all the lands of Islam secure and prosperous, and grant us abundant rain whose flowing bounty spreads across the plains and their hills.

verses.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِنَاسِخِ هَذِهِ الْبُرُودِ الْمُحَبَّرَةِ الْمَوْلِدِيَّةْ ۞ جَعْفَرِ مَنْ إِلَى بَرْزَنْجَ نِسْبَتُهُ وَمُنْتَمَاهْ ۞ وَحَقِّقْ لَهُ الْفَوْزَ بِقُرْبِكَ وَالرَّجَاءَ وَالْأُمْنِيَّةْ ۞ وَاجْعَلْ مَعَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ مَقِيلَهُ وَسُكْنَاهْ ۞ وَاسْتُرْ لَهُ عَيْبَهُ وَعَجْزَهُ وَحَصْرَهُ وَعِيَّهْ
verses.tr: Wa-ghfir li-nāsikhi hādhihi l-burūdi l-muḥabbarati l-mawlidiyyah, Jaʿfari man ilā Barzanja nisbatuhu wa-muntamāh, wa-ḥaqqiq lahu l-fawza bi-qurbika wa-r-rajā'a wa-l-umniyyah, wa-jʿal maʿa l-muqarrabīna maqīlahu wa-suknāh, wa-s-tur lahu ʿaybahu wa-ʿajzahu wa-ḥaṣrahu wa-ʿiyyah.
verses.en: And forgive the author of this beautifully adorned Mawlid, Ja'far, whose origin and affiliation are traced to Barzanj. Grant him the triumph of nearness to You and the fulfilment of his hopes and aspirations. Make his resting place and abode among those brought near to You. Conceal his faults, his weakness, his limitations, and his inability to express himself.

verses.ar: وَلِكَاتِبِهَا وَقَارِئِهَا وَمَنْ أَصَاخَ إِلَيْهَا سَمْعَهُ وَأَصْغَاهْ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلٰى أَوَّلِ قَابِلٍ لِلتَّجَلِّي مِنَ الْحَقِيقَةِ الْكُلِّيَّةْ ۞ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَمَنْ نَصَرَهُ وَوَالَاهْ ۞ مَا شُنِّفَتِ الْآذَانُ مِنْ وَصْفِهِ الدُّرِّيِّ بِأَقْرَاطٍ جَوْهَرِيَّةْ ۞ وَتَحَلَّتْ صُدُورُ الْمَحَافِلِ الْمُنِيفَةِ بِعُقُودِ حُلَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-li-kātibihā wa-qāri'ihā wa-man aṣākha ilayhā samʿahu wa-aṣghāh, Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalā awwali qābilin li-t-tajallī mina l-ḥaqīqati l-kulliyyah, wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-man naṣarahu wa-wālāh, mā shunnifati l-ādhānu min waṣfihi d-durriyyi bi-aqrāṭin jawhariyyah, wa-taḥallat ṣudūru l-maḥāfili l-munīfati bi-ʿuqūdi ḥulāh.
verses.en: And forgive its writer, its reader, and whoever lends his ear to it and listens attentively. O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon the first to receive the manifestation from the Universal Reality, and upon his family, his Companions, and all who supported him and showed him loyalty, for as long as ears are adorned with jewelled earrings fashioned from his pearl-like description, and the foremost places of noble gatherings are adorned with necklaces of his beautiful qualities.

verses.ar: وَأَفْضَلُ الصَّلَاةِ وَأَتَمُّ التَّسْلِيمِ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ ۞ ﴿سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ۞ وَسَلَامٌ عَلٰى الْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾
verses.tr: Wa-afḍalu ṣ-ṣalāti wa-atammu t-taslīmi ʿalā sayyidinā wa-mawlānā Muḥammadin khātami l-anbiyā'i wa-l-mursalīna, wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīna, ﴾subḥāna Rabbika Rabbi l-ʿizzati ʿammā yaṣifūna, wa-salāmun ʿalā l-mursalīna wa-l-ḥamdu li-Llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn.﴿
verses.en: And the finest prayers and most complete peace be upon our master and patron Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets and Messengers, and upon all his family and Companions. “Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Might, far above what they ascribe to Him. Peace be upon the Messengers. And all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.” (37:180–182)
